# Price Tools

Crowdsourced prices from Open Prices (prices.openfoodfacts.org). Prices in different currencies are never mixed.

## getProductPrices

**Get product prices** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Most recent crowdsourced prices for a product (newest first), with store and location.

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `currency` | string | No | ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, MXN) |
| `country` | string | No | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the store (e.g. FR, ES, US) |
| `limit` | integer | No | Maximum number of prices (1–100, default `20`) |

### Output

- `barcode`: string
- `count`: number
- `prices`: object[]
- `note`: string

### Example

```json
// getProductPrices({"barcode":"3017620422003","limit":3})
{
  "barcode": "3017620422003",
  "count": 3,
  "prices": [
    {
      "id": "341942",
      "productBarcode": "3017620422003",
      "productName": "Nutella",
      "price": 4.45,
      "currency": "EUR",
      "isDiscounted": false,
      "store": {
        "id": "7521",
        "name": "Carrefour Express Nancy Leopold",
        "brand": "Carrefour Express"
      },
      "location": {
        "country": "France",
        "countryCode": "FR",
        "city": "Nancy",
        "postalCode": "54100",
        "coordinates": {
          "latitude": 48.6945513,
          "longitude": 6.1775365
        }
      },
      "date": "2026-10-06",
      "proofType": "PRICE_TAG",
      "source": "openprices"
    },
    {
      "id": "330442",
      "productBarcode": "3017620422003",
      "productName": "Nutella",
      "price": 4.68,
      "currency": "EUR",
      "isDiscounted": false,
      "store": {
        "id": "7250",
        "name": "Carrefour Express",
        "brand": "Carrefour Express"
      },
      "location": {
        "country": "France",
        "countryCode": "FR",
        "city": "La Tronche",
        "postalCode": "38700",
        "coordinates": {
          "latitude": 45.2071395,
          "longitude": 5.7447583
        }
      },
      "date": "2026-09-13",
      "proofType": "PRICE_TAG",
      "source": "openprices"
    },
    "… 1 more"
  ],
  "note": "Crowdsourced prices from Open Prices (prices.openfoodfacts.org); coverage varies by country and store."
}
```

## searchPrices

**Search prices** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

| `currency` | string | No | ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, MXN) |
| `country` | string | No | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the store (e.g. FR, ES, US) |
| `discountedOnly` | boolean | No |  (default `false`) |
| `since` | string | No | Only prices on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) |

## getPriceStats

**Get price statistics** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Min, max, average, median and latest price for a product, computed separately for each currency.

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `currency` | string | No | ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, MXN) |
| `country` | string | No | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the store (e.g. FR, ES, US) |

### Output

- `barcode`: string
- `available`: boolean
- `priceCount`: number
- `byCurrency`: object[]
- `firstDate` (optional): string
- `lastDate` (optional): string
- `note`: string

### Example

```json
// getPriceStats({"barcode":"3017620422003"})
{
  "barcode": "3017620422003",
  "priceCount": 5,
  "byCurrency": [
    {
      "currency": "EUR",
      "count": 5,
      "min": 3.65,
      "max": 4.68,
      "avg": 4.26,
      "median": 4.45,
      "latest": {
        "price": 4.45,
        "date": "2026-10-06"
      }
    }
  ],
  "firstDate": "2026-08-28",
  "lastDate": "2026-10-06",
  "available": true,
  "note": "Crowdsourced prices from Open Prices (prices.openfoodfacts.org); coverage varies by country and store. Statistics use up to the 100 most recent prices."
}
```

## findBestPrice

**Find best price** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

| `country` | string | No | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the store (e.g. FR, ES, US) |

- `barcode`: string

## comparePrices

**Compare prices** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Compare median and best prices of several products in one currency, including price per kg/L to find the best value.

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcodes` | string[] | Yes | Product barcodes (2–10 items) |
| `currency` | string | No | Currency to compare in (default: the most common one) |

### Output

- `available`: boolean
- `currency` (optional): string
- `products`: object[]
- `cheapest`: string \| null
- `bestValue`: string \| null
- `missing`: string[]
- `note`: string

### Example

## getPriceHistory

**Get price history** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Monthly median price of a product over the last months, per currency, to spot price trends.

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `months` | integer | No |  (1–60, default `12`) |
| `currency` | string | No | ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, MXN) |

### Output

- `barcode`: string
- `months`: number
- `points`: object[]
- `trend`: `increasing` \| `decreasing` \| `stable` \| `insufficient_data`
- `note`: string

### Example

```json
// getPriceHistory({"barcode":"3017620422003","months":60})
{
  "barcode": "3017620422003",
  "months": 60,
  "points": [
    {
      "month": "2026-08",
      "currency": "EUR",
      "count": 2,
      "median": 4.27,
      "min": 4.05,
      "max": 4.49
    },
    {
      "month": "2026-09",
      "currency": "EUR",
      "count": 2,
      "median": 4.17,
      "min": 3.65,
      "max": 4.68
    },
    "… 1 more"
  ],
  "trend": "stable",
  "note": "Crowdsourced prices from Open Prices (prices.openfoodfacts.org); coverage varies by country and store."
}
```
